subject: Animation
title: Ub Iwerks: The Man Behind Mickey
description: A quick win: understand Ub Iwerks: The Man Behind Mickey.

hook.text: Walt Disney is credited with creating Mickey Mouse, but animator Ub Iwerks actually drew the character.

buildup.text: Iwerks single-handedly animated the first Mickey Mouse cartoons, producing 700 drawings per day.

discovery.text: He was one of the fastest animators in history. His speed made Disney's early success physically possible.

twist.text: Iwerks left Disney over credit disputes. His solo studio failed, and he returned in a diminished role.

climax.text: Iwerks later won two Academy Awards for technical innovations, finally receiving recognition he deserved.

punchline.text: Mickey's true creator spent decades in his partner's shadow.

quiz.question: What was Ub Iwerks' role in the creation of Mickey Mouse?
options: He voiced Mickey in the earliest cartoons
He actually designed and drew Mickey Mouse, animating the first cartoons at 700 drawings per day
He composed the music for Steamboat Willie
